brollSetting: Set in a real Indian legal setting: real Indian people in ordinary modern clothing, real Indian courthouse, government office and small-town locations. Documentary realism, no animation, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render.

globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: crisp white shirt and black blazer (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: a refined private office with deep forest-green panelled walls, a framed botanical print of green leaves on the wall behind him, a tall broad-leaved potted plant to one side, a dark walnut bookshelf holding books and small plants, soft daylight through a window with linen curtains, herringbone wood floor, identical in every scene
globalStyle.gestures: Seated upright behind the desk, forearms and hands resting on the desk surface with small calm natural gestures while he speaks, shoulders relaxed, he stays seated throughout
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, continuous speech filling the full 10 seconds at a brisk explainer pace, NO background music, NO silence at start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: He remains seated behind the desk with his face fully visible and well lit; the room stays soft and out of focus behind him; NO gap or open space beneath the desk, NO table legs, NO chair legs, NO view of the floor under the desk; nothing held in his hands, nothing in front of his face; NO text on screen, NO captions, NO name tags, NO logos, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO standing up, NO camera or studio equipment in frame
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, landscape 16:9. He is SEATED behind a large solid walnut desk, framed from the chest up. The desk surface runs straight across the bottom of the frame and its solid front panel fills the lower edge completely: no gap under the desk, no space beneath it, no table legs and no chair legs are ever visible. Eye level, 50mm lens look, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter filmed in one session in a real office, natural skin texture, accurate lip sync, a warm brass desk lamp and a soft key light falling on his face with gentle catchlights in the eyes, softly out-of-focus room behind him, identical exposure and white balance in every scene
globalStyle.delivery: Energetic educational explainer style, like a confident teacher: brisk pace, continuous speech, no long pauses, natural emphasis on key words; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word

scenes.visual3D: Ravishankar seated behind the walnut desk speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, hands resting on the desk, no props, no graphics, no text.
scenes.dialogue: A man in Bengaluru complained about a civic amenity site allotment. He went to the police, to the Lokayukta, even to the Governor. Nobody acted.

scenes.visual3D: Ravishankar seated behind the walnut desk speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, hands resting on the desk, no props, no graphics, no text.
scenes.dialogue: So he filed a private complaint before a Magistrate. But the trial court found an unverified affidavit, and diverted the case into a Section two twenty three enquiry.
